integrity: The claim is supported by the source definition, the source affine theorem, exact set-inclusion monotonicity, and an exact cat-map substitution. No numerical experiment, external certification, or claimed independent review is used.
scientific_limitations: The finding falsifies only the bounded-distortion Anosov/toral formula stated after Theorem 2.2; it does not propose a corrected general formula.
The affine toral formula in Theorem 2.2 is used as a premise and is not challenged.
An unindexed or later author correction could exist despite targeted correction and erratum searches.
title: A monotonicity obstruction to a claimed Anosov translocal-entropy formula
